senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. עָגַם) to bend; to tie.—V. עוֹגֵין.—Part. pass. f. עֲגוּנָה tied to an absent husband, deserted wife.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 4:2:3">Y. Gitt. IV, beg. 45ᶜ</cite> <he>שלא תהא יושבת ע׳</he> that she may not remain a deserted wife (prevented from marrying again); a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲגוּנוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 1">Ruth R. to I, 13</cite> (ref. to <he>תעגנה</he>, <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 1">ib.</cite>) <he>יכולות … יושבות ע׳ לבלתי וכ׳</he> can you afford to sit tied, so as not to get married? <cite ref="Gittin 33a:7">Gitt. 33ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מפני תקנת ע׳</he> as a measure in favor of deserted wives (that they may be enabled to marry again).

Lev. R. s. 20 הרבה נשים היו יושבות ע׳ ממתינות להם many women (to whom they had made love) remained unmarried, waiting for them (to propose); Tanḥ. Aḥăré 6; a. e.—Trnsf. (of animals in the stable) left lonely.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 8:12">Tosef. B. Kam. VIII, 12</cite> <he>מהו לגדל בהמה … מקיימין את הע׳ שלשים יום</he> how about rearing (for consumption, v.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 80a">B. Kam. 80ᵃ</cite>) small cattle in Palestine?… That which remains last (after the others have been disposed of) should be kept (no more than) thirty days; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 80a:1">B. Kam. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>ובלבד שלא ישהה הע׳ שבהן שלשים יום</he> (Tosef. l. c. <he>האחרונה</he>) provided he do not keep the last of them over thirty days.

<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 10:4">Tosef. Ter. X, 4</cite> <he>מְעַגֶּנֶת שערה בשערה</he> Var. ed. Zuck. (ed. Zuck. <he>מְעַנֶּגֶת</he>, v. <cite ref="P00948"><he>עָנַג</he></cite>; oth. ed. <he>מְעַגֶּלֶת</he>, v. <cite ref="P00089"><he>עָגַל</he></cite>) she may smooth her own hair by rubbing it against her (the priest’s daughter’s) hair.
